context.issue_report: 162 pre-existing integration test failures in api02/api03/obs03/adp05 suites. Root cause: DefinitionError.TransactionFailed at src/definition/store.zig:270. RELEASED requirements are now failing — regression.

task.description:
Fix regression: 162 integration tests failing across api02, api03, obs03, adp05 suites.

Root cause per TEST-RUNNER: DefinitionError.TransactionFailed at src/definition/store.zig line 270.

Steps:
1. Read src/definition/store.zig around line 270 to diagnose the root cause
2. Reproduce by running integration tests with BPM_TEST_DB_URL set and examining failures
3. Fix the root cause in src/definition/store.zig
4. Validate: zig build exits 0, zig build test exits 0
5. Run integration tests again to confirm api02, api03, obs03, adp05 failures are resolved

Constraints: max 5 source files changed. No schema drops. All RELEASED requirements must still pass.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests for API-02, API-03, OBS-03, ADP-05 pass

result.summary: Fixed Category-A regression: DSL-13 merge changed store.zig to use ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_definition_tenant_version, but migration 028 had already been applied to test databases in the old form (unique index, not named constraint). PostgreSQL rejects ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT when only a unique index exists, returning an error caught as DefinitionError.TransactionFailed. Added migration 044_fix_definition_conflict_constraint.sql to idempotently drop the unique index and create the named constraint. After applying migration 044 (zig build migrate with BPM_DB_URL=test DB), api02/api03/obs03/adp05 integration suites pass. zig build and zig build test exit 0. 37 pre-existing failures remain in unrelated suites (EE-09/10, EXT-01/03, IDN-02/03, PD-08 snapshot) — none introduced by this fix.
